name: Default
shortDescription: Open source helpdesk with ticketing, a customer support center, knowledge base, workflows and email-to-ticket, backed by MySQL.

alerts.message: Finish the web installer on first visit. On the database step enter host uvdesk-db, port 3306, user and database uvdesk, and the generated MYSQL_PASSWORD from the environment variables; a later step creates the admin account. Agents sign in at /en/member/login.

Outgoing notifications need an SMTP account (Swift Mailer settings) and email-to-ticket needs an IMAP mailbox, both added in the admin panel after installation. Enabled IMAP mailboxes are checked every 5 minutes.
